column1: # 160 shopping-list lines written by the auditor (Claude, AI) on 2026-10-22, each with the aisle a shopper in a Mexican
# supermarket would look in (16-aisle scheme), BEFORE running them through the matcher.
# WHO CHOSE THE AISLES: an AI. They are judgments, not facts.
# Set a (80 everyday lines) scored 79/80 on the dictionary as the builder left it; set b (80 harder lines: colloquial names,
# brands, compounds, form words) scored 66/79 (its last line, "servitoallas", was added after that run). The override and
# drop lines written after seeing those misses fix most of them, so this file, like test-60 and tricky-40, is a regression
# guard and not evidence of coverage. store = 1 marks a store-dependent row (left out of the score's denominator).
